question: Evaluate $\int_2^4 \frac{dx}{x \ln x}$.
explanation:
Let $u=\ln x$, so $du=\frac{1}{x}dx$.

When $x=2$, $u=\ln2$ and when $x=4$, $u=\ln4$.

Thus the integral becomes $\int_{\ln2}^{\ln4} \frac{du}{u}$.

$=[\ln|u|]_{\ln2}^{\ln4}$.

$=\ln(\ln4)-\ln(\ln2)=\ln\left(\frac{\ln4}{\ln2}\right)$.
